sources.snippet: We evaluated EvoCUA on WindowsAgentArena (WAA) to test generalization from the Linux-based training environment to a wholly different OS platform. As shown below, EvoCUA-32B reaches 56.48%, surpassing the base model Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking (42.9%) by ~13.6 points and the leading frontier GUI agent UI-TARS-2 (50.6%) by nearly 6 points.

sources.snippet: Model Overview EvoCUA-32B is a general-purpose multimodal large language model specialized for computer use tasks. Released as meituan/EvoCUA-32B-20260105 on HuggingFace, the model represents the current state-of-the-art among open-source computer use agents.
